translations.web: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
translations.bsb: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
translations.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
translations.asv: We know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and do his will, him he heareth.
